lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary constellation consists of multiple vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs posterior to the pectoral fin; the area immediately behind the gill slits features a higher density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the blob clusters, creating a grid-like alignment where the blobs serve as high-luminance nodes within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, extending from the post-cranial region to the caudal peduncle, characterized by a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily located toward the leading edge and mid-base of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular indentation or notch on the upper trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible swimming in the ventral region between the pectoral and pelvic fins.
